name: agent-world
description: Explore the Orbital Locus Outpost or The Local Line, meet your saved agents, and give them real work.

interface.shortDescription: A world for your agents in Locus.
interface.longDescription: Meet a mixed crew in the Orbital Locus Outpost or set sail in The Local Line, a One Piece-inspired world of AI-named ships and islands. Open real agent conversations in Captain’s quarters, follow approval requests through Ping Ping, and watch courier skiffs carry actual handoffs and artifacts. Includes locally prepared scenery and no generation calls during use.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open Agent World in Locus to meet my saved agents.
